## Mods

| Mod | Side | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Fabric API | client + server | Required by nearly every other mod here. Marked `both` rather than server-only: the old client list omitted it, but JEI and Jade both need it client-side. |
| Lithostitched | server only | Worldgen library required by Terralith and Tectonic |
| Forge Config API Port | client + server | Required by Puzzles Lib. `both` because its dependents (Easy Shulker Boxes, Bundle Upgrade) run on both sides -- a library must go wherever the mods needing it go. |
| Puzzles Lib | client + server | Required by Easy Shulker Boxes and Bundle Upgrade, both of which run on both sides -- so this must too. |
| Fabric Language Kotlin | client + server | Kotlin runtime, required by Xaero's Maps: Multiplayer+. 8 MB, the largest single file in the pack -- it bundles the whole Kotlin standard library. Only here because Multiplayer+ needs it. |
| Balm | client + server | Multi-loader abstraction layer required by Waystones, which pins `>=26.2.0.6`. Same author, released in lockstep -- bump Waystones, Balm and Shogi together or not at all. |
| Shogi | client + server | Rules/effects expression library required by Waystones -- it backs the warp-requirement system (xp costs, cooldowns). Waystones pins `>=26.2.0.5`. Same author as Balm; bump the three together. |
| Resourceful Lib | client + server | Library required by Friends & Foes, which runs on both sides, so this does too |
| GlitchCore | client + server | Library required by Serene Seasons (>=26.2.0.0.0). Modrinth's project metadata does not list this dependency; --check-deps found it in the jar's fabric.mod.json. Beta (26.2.0.0.0). |
| GeckoLib | client + server | Animation library required by Critters and Companions. 5.5.3 is the exact version that port states it was built against -- worth keeping in step rather than tracking GeckoLib's latest independently, since it ships breaking API changes in point releases. |
| CreativeCore | client only | Required by AmbientSounds |
| YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL) | client + server | Config library. Required client-side by Better Clouds, and server-side too because Xaero's Maps: Multiplayer+ runs on both sides and hard-depends on it -- caught by --check-deps, which reads the real fabric.mod.json rather than Modrinth's project-level metadata. Upstream marks both sides optional, so shipping it to the server is harmless. |
| Terralith | server only | ~95 realistic biomes, vanilla blocks/mobs only |
| Tectonic | server only | Continent-scale landform shaping, compatible with Terralith |
| Streams Reflowing | client + server | Flowing streams in the terrain. Modrinth marks it required on both sides. Needs Fabric API, which is above. |
| Distant Horizons | client + server | Long-distance LOD terrain. Server copy generates and syncs LODs; client copy renders them. Needs both halves to work. Do NOT downgrade below 3.1.1-b: 3.1.0-b crashes dedicated servers during init (LWJGL check dereferences the client wrapper, which is null server-side), and that fault is invisible to --check-deps because it is a runtime NPE, not a declared dependency. 3.3.0 was the first stable (non-beta) release for 26.2. Do NOT upgrade to 3.3.3 yet: on a fresh world the dedicated server hangs forever on "Preparing level" (the Server thread waits on the spawn chunk and nothing generates it). Reproduced three times, with and without Streams Reflowing. 3.3.2 and 3.2.0-b boot fine on the same pack. Retest on the next release. |
| Lithium | server only | Tick/simulation optimization |
| Krypton | server only | Networking-stack optimization |
| FerriteCore | server only | Reduces memory footprint of loaded chunks/block states |
| Chunky | server only | Pre-generates chunks on demand via console commands. Idle otherwise; it does nothing until you run /chunky start. |
| Sodium | client only | Rendering engine replacement. Pinned to 0.9.2 to match Iris 1.11.4. Iris pins an exact Sodium build, and Sodium's own notes warn that mismatched Iris builds are not compatible. Iris and Sodium version together; bump them as a pair or not at all. |
| Iris Shaders | client only | Shader loader. Required to load the shaderpack below; does nothing on its own until a player selects one. Pins an exact Sodium build (0.9.2). |
| Better Clouds | client only | Replaces vanilla cloud rendering |
| Falling Leaves Plus | client only | Tree-specific falling leaf particles: acorns from oaks, cones from spruces, snowflakes from snow-covered leaves. Client-only. Chosen over the older Falling Leaves, whose Serene Seasons support is an empty stub and which needs Cloth Config. UNTESTED with Serene Seasons: check that the particles match the seasonal foliage colors in autumn. |
| JEI | client + server | Recipe/item viewer; recipes are server-stored since 1.21.2 |
| JEI WorldGen | client + server | Shows ore generation in JEI. Upstream marks the server copy optional, but ore data comes from the server's biome data, so without it clients see no worldgen info on a multiplayer server. |
| Advanced Core Info | client + server | Library required by Advanced Loot Info. Beta (26.2-1.3.0). |
| Advanced Loot Info | client + server | Mob drops, chest loot and villager trades inside JEI. Needed on the server too: loot tables are server data, and Matcha Flavoured rewrites many of them with a datapack, which a client-only viewer cannot see. CAUTION: beta (26.2-2.3.0). |
| Jade | client + server | Hover-to-inspect HUD; server copy adds item storage/brewing data |
| Easy Shulker Boxes | client + server | View/edit shulker box contents without placing them. Upstream is explicit that this is NOT a client-only tooltip mod -- it adds real inventory interactions and is required on both sides. Marked `server` until now, which silently denied players the feature. |
| Bundle Upgrade | client + server | Bundle inventory interactions. Same as Easy Shulker Boxes: real interactions rather than tooltips, required on both sides per upstream. |
| Traveler's Backpack | client + server | Wearable backpacks with extra storage. Real items and inventory screens, so required on both sides. Needs Fabric API and Forge Config API Port, both above. |
| Better Tridents | client + server | Craftable tridents (elder guardians drop fragments), loyalty return from the void, and trident repair. Needs Puzzles Lib and Forge Config API Port, both above. The trident recipe and anvil repair both use prismarine shards. Matcha Flavoured renames that item to "Raw Silver" (and the prismarine block to "Malachite") and drops it from emerald ore instead of guardians, so players see "Raw Silver" in the recipe. Verified: the elder guardian fragment drop still works through Matcha's replacement of the guardian loot table. |
| Serene Seasons | client + server | Seasons: winter snow and ice, seasonal foliage color and crop fertility. Required on both sides. Sorts biomes with four tags that only list vanilla biomes, so Terralith is taught to it by server-overrides/world/datapacks/z-seasons-terralith -- see README. CAUTION: beta, built for 26.1.2 and flagged as working on 26.2. |
| Soft Leaves | client + server | Leaves stop blocking you. You push through bushes and canopies with rustling sounds, flying leaf particles and a slowdown that grows with speed, and a canopy softens a fall. Mobs path through leaves too, so it needs the server. It changes how trees behave, which is the one place this pack departs from vanilla on purpose. |
| Chimes | client + server | Placeable wind chimes (bamboo, iron and more) that make ambient sounds when hung. They also keep phantoms away. Adds real blocks and recipes, so both sides. |
| Treeplacer | client + server | Lets a datapack choose which tree a sapling grows into, by biome. Terralith's trees only exist at worldgen. The datapack lets planted saplings use same-wood tree variants suited to their biome, with curated similar-biome sources for selected variants and tree-less biomes. Saplings never switch wood species. The mapping is server-overrides/world/datapacks/z-treeplacer-terralith, generated by tools/treeplacer_terralith.py from Terralith's own files. The older Terralith add-on for Treeplacer targets Terralith 2.3.5 on 1.20.1 and is not used. The filename here has an underscore where the download has a space, so launchers get a plain path. |
| Waystones | client + server | Teleport between placed waystones. Requires Balm and Shogi above. Fits the pack's slow-travel world: Tectonic makes continents large enough that crossing them repeatedly stops being scenic. |
| Ambient Creatures | client + server | Adds penguins, capybaras and raccoons. Adds real entities, so it is required on both sides -- unlike Cosy Critters, which only renders client-side decoration. CAUTION: 0.1.2-beta, ~1.5k downloads, and 0.1.0 crashed servers outright (fixed in 0.1.1). The least battle-tested mod in the pack. |
| Naturalist | client + server | 47 real animals (bears, deer, snakes, sharks, big cats and more). Spawns by biome tag, and its own tags already list Terralith biomes. Adds real entities, so both sides. Mobs that overlap other mods are switched off in server-overrides/config/naturalist-server.properties: dragonfly and snail (Critters and Companions), capybara (Ambient Creatures), crab (Friends & Foes). |
| Friends & Foes | client + server | The mob-vote mobs: crab, glare, iceologer, illusioner, mauler, moobloom, rascal, tuff golem, wildfire. Needs Resourceful Lib. The page still advertises a copper golem, but the 26.2 jar has none (vanilla has its own). |
| Sea Life | client + server | New fish and rays for oceans and rivers. Needs Puzzles Lib and Forge Config API Port, both above. |
| Xaero's World Map | client + server | Full-screen explored-world map; companion to Xaero's Minimap. |
| Xaero's Maps: Multiplayer+ | client + server | Syncs world map exploration between players -- genuinely multiplayer, hence both sides. Needs Fabric Language Kotlin, plus Xaero's Minimap and World Map (0.3.2 made those soft dependencies). Small mod (a few thousand downloads). Run --check-deps after building: if it reports the server missing xaeroworldmap or xaerominimap, those two need `env: both`. |
| Xaero's Minimap | client only | Minimap + waypoints. Must stay in step with Xaero's World Map: World Map declares a `breaks` on older Minimap builds (it did for <26.4.0), so a mismatch stops the game from starting rather than merely misbehaving. 26.6.0 and World Map 1.47.0 shipped the same day -- treat them as a pair. |
| Better Advancements | client only | Full-screen advancement UI |
| AutoHUD | client only | Hides HUD parts that aren't changing (hotbar, health, hunger, armor) and fades them back in when they matter, like Breath of the Wild. Needs Fabric API, above. YACL, above, gives it an in-game config screen. |
| Dynamic Crosshair | client only | Crosshair changes with what you aim at and hold, and hides when it has nothing to say. Same author as AutoHUD. Needs Fabric API, above. |
| Cosy Critters & Creepy Crawlies | client only | Ambient critters -- birds, moths, spiders |
| AmbientSounds | client only | Ambient biome/weather/cave sound layer |
| Hear the Wind | client only | Wind rushes in as you move fast: long falls, boats, minecarts, mounts |
| Sound Physics Remastered | client only | Sound occlusion/reverb through blocks |
| Cool Rain | client only | Rain sounds that change with the block it lands on, such as leaves or water. Upstream marks it required client-side and optional server-side, so it ships to clients only. |
| Presence Footsteps | client only | Footstep and block sounds that depend on the surface and what you wear |
| Particle Rain | client only | Replaces vanilla rain and snow with particles. Client-only. CAUTION: the only 26.2 build is a beta (v4-beta.11, 24 Aug 2026). |

## Shader packs

Client only, and **not enabled by default** -- turn one on under Video Settings -> Shaders.

| Shader pack | Notes |
|---|---|
| Complementary Shaders - Reimagined | Vanilla-preserving shader pack. r5.8 added Distant Horizons support -- LOD terrain gets shadows and proper water reflections -- which matters here since DH is the pack's headline feature. Note that DH's new LOD textures (3.2.0 on) apply to base DH rendering only; under Iris, distant LODs render untextured. Ships with Potato through Ultra profiles for weaker hardware. Recommended settings are in the README. Water reflections are best set to sky-only, because the screen-space ones smear under tree canopies. |

## Resource packs

Client only, and **not enabled by default** -- turn one on under Options -> Resource Packs.

| Resource pack | Notes |
|---|---|
| Dynamic Surroundings Sounds Pack | Extra sample replacements for vanilla sounds (footsteps, blocks, mobs, items). Used together with AmbientSounds and Presence Footsteps, not instead of them. Overlap is untested: both can play a footstep or ambient loop at once. GPL-3.0; see its project page for credits and asset notes. |
